onset.Description: Time of the annotated first N2 sleep epoch relative to the beginning of this recording.

duration.Description: Duration of the event marker. Zero denotes a point annotation of N2 onset, not the duration of an N2 sleep epoch.

sample.Description: Zero-based sample index of the N2 onset annotation at 128 Hz. BrainVision marker positions are one-based and therefore equal sample + 1.

value.Description: Numeric code assigned to the supplied annotation; this does not imply a physical stimulus or hardware trigger.

Levels.n2_onset: Onset of the first N2 sleep epoch, the prediction target for Track 03.
